notes.envelope: Per fold, envelope monitors fitted on stacked clean + degraded training clips (audio: prosody clean + snr10; visual: mnet clean + compress), P99 from inner GroupKFold(4) by actor, log q standardised with inner OOF mean and sd.
notes.gating: run_slg state machine (ADWIN delta 0.002, recent-15 mean threshold 1.0). Predictions are MCT late fusion over active models. Clean-fit and envelope rows differ only in monitors.
notes.alerting: Clean-fit monitors are reported as the alerting view (detection tables).
notes.control_false_alarms: Degraded marks per 1000 clips in S3 clean control streams.
notes.clean_fit_marks: Clean-fit SLG marks are identical in the clean-trained and MCT regimes (asserted).
